1436 is a leap year (divisible by 4).  
From 1436-10-31, add:  
31 days left in Oct → go to 1436-11-30 (0 days added yet).  
Add remaining 222 days:  
Nov 30 to Dec 31 = 31 days → 191 left.  
1437 is not leap (1437 % 4 = 1), so Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30 = 31+28+31+30+31+30 = 181 days.  
191 - 181 = 10 days left → into July.  
So 1437-07-10.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1437-07-10
